title: Projection Sorcery
description: This mod adds a new potion, Projection Sorcery, with a unique 24-frame effect
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef4f6c6d8da89da3c8601a5fc175a59850715da4.png)

**The Projection Sorcery mod** - adds a new potion to the game that temporarily grants the player Naoya Zenin's abilities, specifically incredible movement speed and attack speed, as well as a special attack that can literally “shatter” an opponent if their HP is below 50%.

Limitations - No weapons of any kind may be used.
Obtaining - With a certain chance, if you trade with a resident of the Cleric profession who has reached the Master level, they will be able to sell you this potion for 24 emeralds, up to a maximum of 3 units.
